blank_linear_rows.case_format: donor / number of free nongauge signs / allowed reference losses / start. Every search uses the real original mesh, all 13+194+985 loss premises, spherical Euler, fixed color gauge, no phase or pairing hint, and the blank projection without continuous flows.
blank_linear_rows.policy_format: explicit residual parity rows (0,1,2) / forbidden pair row (weak,hull,none) / legal-neighbor row (n,y). The global signed inventory always posts both initial blank color parities.

screen.baseline_source: Reused the six completed one-node baseline controls and two 60-second held-outs from cases.blank and cases.heldout-blank.

held_out.unrestricted_control: All 159 nongauge signs free, cap 90. It is a feasible-side control. It does not establish the minimum loss.

pinned_saved_check.method: Each authentic phase and its global complement revalidated every actual pair and pin. The C case with loss <=36 or a forbidden compulsory mate refused the save.

blank_linear_rows.reproduce: python bench_r35_blank_rows.py --tiles data/tiles.json --output blank-results --seconds 65 --cases c/80/36/cold c/80/37/cold c/112/36/cold c/112/37/cold a/159/90/cold --policies 2-weak-n 2-hull-n 2-none-y 2-weak-y 2-hull-y
